block: Cast iron, closed deck, 7 main bearings
popular_for: Extremely high boost capability on stock internals (500–1000+ hp documented)

exhaust.port_shape: Rectangular / D-shaped (GTE); more rounded on GE
exhaust.stud_notes: Factory studs; shorter aftermarket studs often used for single-turbo manifolds. 2JZ-GE uses 8 studs on some configurations. Protrusion of short studs ~22 mm from head flange.
exhaust.gasket_notes: OEM multi-layer or aftermarket MLS; port matching critical for high power
useful_checks: Overall flange length consistent with I6 spacing

sources_notes: Aftermarket manifold makers (TurboWorks, Vibrant, etc.) list 32x42 mm ports. Stud kits widely available as M10x1.25. Cross-check physical head for exact spacing.
